_doc: Worst cases of the six protocol rows of talk/scenes/data/tiers.json, generated by scripts/tiers/measure_protocols.py (deployed parameters read at mainnet block 26307942). The top-level fields of each row are over NORMAL inputs, the envelope in 'normal_envelope' (the user, 2026-10-30: '1000% apr doesnt make sense. let's use normal inputs', then: up to the rates live markets actually charged); 'domain_worst' keeps the full documented domain and 'capped_67pct' the same envelope capped at Aave's largest live rate (67.73% APR), both for the notes. 'held_floor' (the 'both must pass' rule): for H in 25, 14, 10, the fewest digits held over the envelope's inputs where the result's format holds at least H significant digits at the true value (log10(|truth| / unit) >= H; 'capacity' is that count at the worst input), null when no input qualifies. 'short18' (the user's blended number, replacing 'both must pass'): the worst over the envelope of max(0, min(format digits at the value, 18) - digits held), format digits = log10(|exact| / unit), digits held = -log10(relative error) clamped at 0, with its input ('short18_input', 'short18_format_digits', 'short18_digits_held'); 'correctly_rounded' is true iff worst_units < 1 everywhere (every answer within one unit in its stated direction). 'worst_units' is the largest |v - t| over the searched inputs in units of the result's own last place ('unit'), at 'worst_input_units'; 'digits_lost' = log10(max(worst_units, 1)), so an answer within one unit (correctly rounded, or a floor short of one unit) loses 0. 'worst_digits' is the fewest correct digits held, -log10(relative error) floored to two decimals (0 for an error of 100% or more), at 'worst_input'. 'live_*' (Aave, Morpho) are over the live positions themselves: live_min is the file's digitsInterest (token units, against each truth it states); live_worst_units is the factor's error in units (Aave: the 39 borrows; Morpho: wTaylorCompounded at each of the 252 markets' charged rate). Truth: the model each protocol documents, mpmath at 120 digits. No tier: the coordinator grades.

normal_envelope.annual_rate_max_source: the largest rate a live market charged: Morpho, 7.9999999999 per year (800% APR, the AdaptiveCurveIrm's ceiling, 28 of 252 Morpho markets above Aave's largest live rate 0.6773)
normal_envelope.utilisation: 0 to 100% for Compound's curves and the FraxLend and Euler rate models
normal_envelope.lower_rates: Aave, SparkLend from 0.0001% APR; Morpho from the IRM's floor 0.025%; FraxLend and Euler from their deployed minimum
normal_envelope.upper_rates_per_row: each row's rate is capped at the smaller of 800% APR and its own documented maximum: Aave 800%, SparkLend 320%, Morpho 800%, Compound its curves (35.2% supply, 40.0% borrow), FraxLend starting full-utilisation rate 800% (clamp 10000%), Euler rate at target 200% (its MAX)

checks: Aave factor equals deployed.factor on all 39 live borrow positions; Morpho wTaylorCompounded equals deployed.taylor on all 252 live markets (accrual-deployed.json)
FraxLend equals the ladder's LadderFraxlend raw on 40 cells and Euler equals LadderEuler on 20 cells (ladder.json adaptive-rate, the adapters' wide clamps)
